author: GitHub
description:
The World Cup might be over, but exploring the data behind every match is just getting started. World Cup 2026 data portraits convert over 1,500 match events, from passes and touches to cards and shots, into interactive 3D visualizations. Built with self-hosted Three.js, local assets, and GPU fallbacks, this open-source project offers a new perspective on every game. Explore how creative data visualization turns raw sports metrics into a living story.

#WorldCup #Football #DataVisualization
